name: Mount Sharp study area, Gale crater

subcell.note: Derived metric: count of ~1 m source pixels in each cell whose slope exceeds the limit. Not a hazard probability.

crs: Mars 2000 sphere (ESRI:104905), planetocentric lat, east-positive lon

method.elevation: mean of each cell's 4 x 4 source pixels
method.slope: central difference between neighbouring cells (two-cell baseline), in degrees, stored rounded up
method.sourceGrid: 4096 x 4096 pixels over the same bounding box, exported in 16 tiles with bilinear interpolation

source.dataset: MRO HiRISE, Gale Crater DEM (Gale_DEM_SMG_1m), 1 m/px
source.urlNote: first of 16 tiles (4 x 4, north-west first); the others shift the bbox by a quarter of the area
